sophia_cs: Quick sync — Vespara Labs private VPC KMS/HSM failover readiness. TL;DR: eu-west-1 key rotation caused ~1m degraded KMS latency yesterday; HSM replication lag observed. Need checklist + smoke test schedule.

leo_infra: Got it. I pulled logs — saw KMS 504 spikes around 03:12 UTC. HSM replication lag ~2s at 03:10-03:15. No token loss.

anita_se: Onboarding note: customer completed key-inventory run. Their HSM cluster uses HSM-A (primary) in eu-west-1, with read replica in eu-central-1.

jamal_support: Customer reported 5 error-rate spikes in last 24h; all tied to key rotation window. I'll attach example trace in a sec.

jamal_support: ```
ERROR 2026-03-18T03:12:05Z KMS request timeout key_id=kv-xxxx region=eu-west-1 status=504
TRACEID=abc123
```

kms-ops-bot: Automated alert: KMS rotation job completed for ve-svc-01 (eu-west-1) at 03:14 UTC. Replication status: delayed -> consolidated.

sophia_cs: Risk/renewal note: this customer is sensitive to downtime (healthcare). If we see another rotation-related incident in next 2 weeks we should escalate and propose scheduled maintenance windows + optional SLA uplift.

leo_infra: Action items: 1) Schedule staged failover smoke test in staging + prod shadow at 15:00 PT tomorrow. 2) Run full key fetch latency run across regions. 3) Validate HSM replication settings and bump monitoring thresholds.

anita_se: I can run the smoke test and coordinate with Vespara's infra contact (they're ok with a 30-min maintenance window). Can we get a second for the test window? :thumbsup: 

jamal_support: I'll own runbook updates and capture customer postmortem notes. Also collecting cost/spend impact — they saw a 12% spike in KMS API ops (retries) during the window.

leo_infra: Pre-test checklist (short):
- verify key versions pinned
- confirm backup key access
- ensure fallback route to regional model variant
- set sampling rate to 100% for the test

sophia_cs: Cool. Proposed attendees: @anita_se, @leo_infra, @jamal_support, @vespara_oncall (customer). I'll create calendar invite.

anita_se: One more: run `redwoodctl kms test --region eu-west-1 --failover-sim` in staging first. Expect ~5-10s cold start.

leo_infra: I'll pre-warm caches and increase batch window to reduce token pressure during test.

kms-ops-bot: Scheduled task created: kms-failover-smoke-1967456789 -> run at 2026-03-19T22:00:00Z (staging). Notifying oncall.

sophia_cs: Thanks team. Post-test, capture: latency percentiles, error rate deltas, key fetch counts, and any HSM replication lag numbers. Tag me and I'll include in renewal health deck.

vespara_oncall: (customer) Thanks — confirmed 15:00 PT tomorrow. We will have ops on slack channel and SSO ready.

jamal_support: I'll post a short template for the post-test report in this thread after the run.

anita_se: ack, prepping the test script now.

sophia_cs: Closing loop — we'll review results in Monday CSM sync if all good. :white_check_mark:
